questions.question: Which statement best describes asthma?
options: A non-infectious disease that causes breathing difficulties
An infectious disease caused by a viral infection
A bacterial infection affecting the digestive system
A contagious illness spread through coughing

They become narrower, making it harder to breathe
They fill completely with blood
They break down and disappear permanently

questions.question: Which device is commonly used to deliver medication directly to the lungs to treat asthma symptoms?
options: A syringe
An inhaler
A thermometer
A stethoscope

questions.question: What defines an infectious disease?
options: It is caused only by an unbalanced diet
It can be passed from one organism to another
It cannot be transmitted between living things
It is inherited strictly through family genes

questions.question: Which types of organisms or agents cause infectious diseases?
options: Red blood cells and white blood cells
Pathogens including viruses and some bacteria
Vitamins and minerals
Plant hormones and enzymes

questions.question: Which statement is true regarding non-infectious diseases?
options: They are always caused by airborne viruses
They can be caught by touching an infected person
They cannot be passed from one organism to another
They are spread through contaminated drinking water

questions.question: Which combination of habits increases a person's risk of developing lifestyle diseases?
options: Eating an unbalanced diet and lacking regular exercise
Eating a balanced diet and exercising regularly
Drinking plenty of water and sleeping eight hours daily
Avoiding tobacco and walking every day

questions.question: How are medicines best defined in healthcare?
options: Drugs taken purely for recreation and entertainment
Substances that are always illegal to possess
Drugs that people take when they are ill
Nutrients that replace normal food intake

options: Antibiotics and painkillers
Depressants and stimulants
Nutrients and vitamins
Vaccines and antibodies

Heroin
